A-30 — Starting selection brief
Manufacturer: Boya Gongdao

A 35 kg crawler inspection robot that swims, rolls onto a wall and crawls along it, for close inspection of tanks, pools, pipes and structure surfaces to 100 m.

Vehicle weight: 35 kg
Depth rating: 100 m
Payload: 3 kgf (test method to confirm)
Dimensions: 400 × 400 × 300 mm
Thrusters: 6 (2 horizontal vector + 4 vertical)
Camera: 1080p; ±90° tilt
Power: External tethered supply

Configuration note: The manufacturer designs the A-30 for one-person deployment and lists compatibility with a line-tracking system. The 3 kgf payload is expressed as a force; confirm how it was measured. NDT probes, their certification and the inspection procedure are specified per project.

Confirm current specifications and delivered scope with the manufacturer before purchase.
